graph_snapshot.note: The course/skill graph is rebuilt in memory from the catalogue + taxonomy on every run (no persisted production snapshot); its identity is the hash of these inputs plus the code commit.

retrieval_index.note: BM25 (k1=1.5, b=0.75) and the dense index (sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, CPU) are rebuilt from the catalogue text at run time; no index file is persisted. Identity = catalogue hash + model revision in the HF cache section.
